name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (render / horizontal_bar_segments). No address residue. Accurately reflects purpose confirmed by sole caller fd2_render_hp_or_mp_bar_proportional: paints a 1-pixel-segmented horizontal HP/MP bar.
purpose: Render a 1-pixel-segmented horizontal HP/MP bar at dst_offset by blitting per-pixel segment sprites (left cap + middle run + right cap) from the UI/anim sprite sheet.
logic_summary: If filled_count==0: blit 0x65 empty-middle sprites (0x1D) at dst_offset+1..dst_offset+0x65, then an empty right cap (0x1E) at dst_offset+0x66; final_sprite=0x1E. Else: blit left cap (sprite_base) at dst_offset, then (filled_count-1) middle sprites (sprite_base+1) at dst_offset+1.., then right cap (sprite_base+2); final_sprite=sprite_base+2. Both branches converge on one final blit whose offset (cap_offset) is the value last left in EAX by that branch's LEA: dst_offset+filled_count for the filled branch, dst_offset+0x66 for the empty branch (the empty loop counter reaches 0x66, NOT +filled_count==+0). All segments source data_fd2_ui_anim_sprite_sheet_ptr.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_horizontal_bar_segments(uint32 dst_offset, uint32 dst_pitch, uint32 filled_count, uint32 sprite_base)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Destination buffer byte-offset where the bar's left edge starts (caller passes overlay_buffer + 0x2A06 for HP, +0x41C6 for MP, etc.). Forwarded as the first arg of every fd2_blit_sheet_sprite_at_offset call, advanced per segment.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_1; src already uses the correct semantic name dst_offset. Stage-2 rename to dst_offset.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Destination surface stride/pitch in bytes (caller passes 0x140), forwarded unchanged as the pitch arg of fd2_blit_sheet_sprite_at_offset.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_2; src uses dst_pitch. Stage-2 rename to dst_pitch.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Number of filled bar segments; 0 selects the fully-empty rendering branch, otherwise drives the filled-middle loop bound (1..filled_count-1) and the trailing-cap offset.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_3; src uses filled_count. Stage-2 rename to filled_count.

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Base sprite-sheet index for the bar's color theme (0x17 HP red, 0x1A MP blue); used as left-cap index, +1 for middle segments, +2 for the right cap. Ghidra typed it byte* due to param-order/type confusion; it is an integer sprite index.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name dst_buf is misleading (it is the sprite base index, not a destination buffer) and is also wrongly typed byte*. src already declares it as uint32 sprite_base. Stage-2 rename to sprite_base (the function-prototype type is already uint32 in protos.h).

returns.semantics: No return value; renders directly into the destination surface via fd2_blit_sheet_sprite_at_offset.
